definitions.explanation: The space maintained between one's vehicle and the vehicle ahead while driving. A key concept in safe driving and traffic regulations.

examples.japanese: {車間距離|しゃかんきょり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。

examples.english: On rainy days, keep a greater following distance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{車間距離|しゃかんきょり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詰|つ}め→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{追突事故|ついとつじこ}→追突事故：24064_tsuitotsujiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Closing the following distance too much on the expressway can cause rear-end collisions.

notes:
USAGE:
{車間距離|しゃかんきょり} is a compound of ⟦{車間|しゃかん}→車間：27024_shakan⟧ (between vehicles) and ⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧ (distance). It is used frequently in driving instructions, traffic safety campaigns, and news reports about accidents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車間距離|しゃかんきょり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (maintain following distance)
- {車間距離|しゃかんきょり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧ (close the gap between vehicles)
- {車間距離|しゃかんきょり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧ (following distance is too short)
- ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な{車間距離|しゃかんきょり} (sufficient following distance)

DRIVING NOTE:
In Japan, the recommended {車間距離|しゃかんきょり} on expressways is the distance traveled in about 2 seconds. Tailgating (⟦{煽|あお}り→煽り：10928_aori⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧) has been a significant traffic safety issue and was made a criminal offense in 2020.
